title: Make standard s-no-wildcard-dependencies pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check --record s-no-wildcard-dependencies` no longer fails s-no-wildcard-dependencies.

Why: adoption found this reflex standard failing: exit 1 from node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const bad=[];const scan=(f,keys,re)=>{if(!fs.existsSync(f))return;let j;try{j=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"))}...
Files: the files the failing check names (run the Proof command).
